statements.status_notes: Upstream fixed CVE-2026-124317 (out-of-bounds read in unknown_toUtf8() and unknown_toUtf16() in xmltok.c for application-registered unknown encodings) in libexpat PR #1492, commit 3d77567 (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/3d77567612994172f9d09b46f31bb604e16fb08d), which makes both converters check the multi-byte sequence length against the remaining input and return XML_CONVERT_INPUT_INCOMPLETE. No Expat release carries it yet and Debian lists it as unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-124317). DHI backported that commit to its Debian 13 expat 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 packages from the range's fixed version on. Checked the libexpat1 library with its debug symbols for every 2.9.0 build and the last 2.8.3 build, on amd64 and arm64: in the fixed version and the one later build, unknown_toUtf8() and unknown_toUtf16() are larger than in the earlier builds (amd64 460 and 220 bytes against 421 and 181, arm64 376 and 264 against 348 and 208), matching the added length checks, while other functions such as XmlUtf8Encode() and unknown_isName() are unchanged; the package changelog of those two builds also records the backport. Every earlier published build (upstream 2.7.1, 2.8.2, 2.8.3 and the first two 2.9.0 builds) lacks it and stays on the affected side of the range.
